title: The Uniform of the Palatinate
author: Beatrix Ashgrove
blurb: Noor Eastwick, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
